name: Sueyoi
quote: The most dazzling of minerals lie in the darkness, awaiting to be discovered.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. It's time to start working.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: The Oasis offers such lovely working conditions. If I can keep working in such a bright environment... Never mind, it doesn't really suit me.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Still working overtime? How hard-working, or perhaps... you slacked off during the day?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: This is a rare piece of mineral, not a night light. You like it? You can keep it.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Compared to processing minerals, I prefer working with the remains of creatures that were once alive, though both are laden with history.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Professor, you seem quite knowledgeable about history. Fancy a look underground? Books lie, but the strata of the earth don't. There you will always find history in its truest form.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Will you reject me the way he does... or are you still sizing me up?

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: I don't want to be with her. Please make other arrangements.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: This way, follow me.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hmm... Head patting is a gesture to offer comfort, right? I don't need comforting.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: You seem quite interested in my bodysuit? Don't worry, I won't comment on your predilections.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: You're still at work, right? Should you really be giving me all your attention?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Right, I'll get it done.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I am Sueyoi, mineral sampler Doll from 42Lab. Give me assignments as you see fit.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Does this... really work?

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I will catch up to her, I swear.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Now I'm worthy of your attention, right?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Me? Sure, I'll complete the mission, I promise.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Phew... Off I go.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: You're not needed here.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: ...See, I can actually do it.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Thank you for having faith in me, Professor.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: No... I can't let the Professor down.

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Me...? Are you serious? Huh? Embarrassed? Why would I be embarrassed?! I just think someone is being too hasty with their decision, like the idiot who gobbled up food without even looking at it and then regretting it too late when it tasted awful. Even now, there is no backing out for you... I won't give you the chance. This ring is mine now.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Will I still get to stay by your side this time next year? No... I just feel... very grateful... that you're letting me stay.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
Are you free today, Professor? I want to visit the museum with you.
I'll take that as a yes. I'll go and prepare for the trip then. I look happy? Hmm, is it so obvious...?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Origami and embroidery, huh... I don't really know how to do either, but I carved this pendant from a fire opal. I hope you'll like it.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: You're joining in the festivities, Professor? You didn't actually have to put on makeup. You look perfect for Halloween after working overtime.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: I often wonder if the deities that humans worship actually exist. Do people also mark and celebrate the births of these beings that were so mighty and formidable in the days of old?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text:
There's no point for either humans or Dolls to celebrate their birthdays, is there? I don't really understand why we keep making a fuss about being a year closer to our demise. Isn't it better to spend this day on self-maintenance to prolong our existence?
If I must say something to wish you well... I hope you won't be decommissioned too soon, and I hope I'll be there with you until the very end.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: What do I like...? Is that really important? Is it not enough to just follow your instructions? That was what they asked of me, and it was how I have always worked. If you must ask, it's called "being reasonably utilized". Does this answer satisfy you?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Working in the Oasis is a blessing. The mines in the real world are not so clean. Dolls don't get black lung, but working in such terrible conditions still inflicts irreversible damage on us. I was just a mineral sampler so I already had it easy. Those human miners... or even the mining Dolls... most of them don't live long enough to retire.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Are you that interested in my past? What an odd hobby you have. Getting your subordinates to reveal their past so that you can get a handle on their weaknesses? I suppose I shouldn't be surprised.
Sorry to disappoint, but there is nothing exciting about the experience I can recall. What about you, why don't you share some of yours? A self-taught field commander. I am very curious about your life in the real world. It must be really, really tough, doing scientific research in a war-ridden lab, hmm, is, that, right, Professor?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Hatsuchiri and me? Why are you asking about that? Playing the nice, approachable teacher helping a problem child? There are so many agents in the Oasis, if you have time to do this with every single one of us, you must be pretty idle indeed.
You still insist on knowing? How tenacious of you. There's nothing interesting between her and me. You'll just get bored if I tell you everything. You're probably the only one who would pick me over her, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
I hate it when people ask me about my past. What does my past say about me? People determine what I'm worth based on just a few rows of text on my resume and don't even consider what I can actually offer...
Am I being too harsh? These are my genuine thoughts. I knew you would be different. From the very start, you've seen me for who I am, not "the Doll of the same model as Hatsuchiri." So I will treat you the same way no matter who you actually are in the real world. I will do everything I can to repay what you have done for me, so keep your eyes on me... please.

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: Sure.

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Huh?

career:
BPT2 is a scientific research Doll of 42Lab, fine-tuned for geological studies. Compared to existing predecessors, BPT2's geological analysis modules were further upgraded, with significant improvements in detection, precision, mobility and movement speed while underground, as well as being capable of carrying more instruments. Proportionally to these upsides, however, BPT2 suffered in continuity and adaptability to extreme conditions when compared to previous models, and also expended more energy.

Sueyoi participated in various cryptid organism surveys and mineral excavation programs, all with significant success. After the passing of Sueyoi's designer, many serious complications arose from self-destructive behaviors that damaged his neural modules. After heavy consideration, 42Lab signed Sueyoi into Project Neural Cloud during his maintenance period.
infoStories:
Sueyoi was the second Doll created by Professor Reed, the head of the "Cryptid Organism Survey" program. With great investment from 42Lab, Sueyoi's ability to adjust to underground environments surpassed even his predecessor, BPT1. From the very first day he was put into trials, Sueyoi continually outperformed 42Lab's expectations, not only because of his more advanced systems, but also his assiduous attitude. The researchers would say jokingly that Reed even wrote those ideals about one's work into Sueyoi's base code.

During the trial period, Reed often arranged for Sueyoi and his "sister", Hatsuchiri of the BPT1 model, to perform their duties together. Limited by his energy consumption, Sueyoi's runtime would not be as long as Hatsuchiri's, yet he always refused to end his shift before her. Whenever the two headed off together, it'd be morning when they departed, and the dead of night when they returned.

Hatsuchiri is much more unhurried and placid in nature, and it was not an uncommon occurrence for her to spend her time wandering around, doing as she pleased, but why did Sueyoi insist on pushing himself, refusing to end his shift before Hatsuchiri did? The logistics workers did not understand.

When the people from logistics made small talk, they'd often subconsciously compare Hatsuchiri and Sueyoi. In addition to their differences in capabilities, they were polar opposites in temperament as well. There was a saying amongst the logistics workers: Whenever one of the two was back from an assignment, you could tell who it was by the sound of their footsteps. If the sounds were slow and lackadaisical, as if their owner still yearned for the comfort of the underground, it'd be Hatsuchiri. If the steps were steady and decisive, travelling towards Reed's office, not a trace of hesitation to be found, it'd be Sueyoi.

Another legend about Sueyoi was that he never smiled. Even when the researchers helped him through his usual checks, his face would be as still as water, mechanically proceeding with each and every step of the inspections. This legend, however, was not to last. A researcher was making his way back to his office after hours for reasons, and passed by Reed's office, with its lights still bright. There was a figure sitting opposite Reed, engrossed in discussion over complex matters of investigation, an astonishing trace of excitement on their face...

"One Reed on our hands is enough already... and I thought I saw two!"
—The Shocked Researcher

Since the day Sueyoi was created, his designer, Professor Reed was met with a decision: 42Lab requested that he send off one Doll between Sueyoi and Hatsuchiri to the Mineral Sampling Program, as returns for their significant investment. From another viewpoint, this could perhaps explain why Sueyoi was so zealous. Anyone could see that he was adamant in staying by Reed's side.

Researchers from other departments came to rope Sueyoi in and perhaps convince him to join their respective programs. They found themselves on his wrong side, and became the recipients of his not unimpressive degree of contempt. In his own words, there was no chance he'd "not come out on top in this contest". However, his performance was perhaps not as impressive as his words would suggest. Afterwards, it was found that he submitted a variety of requests himself, assigning himself more and more expeditions.

In any case, his performance during his trial period was undoubtedly very impressive. When Reed announced that Hatsuchiri would stay, and Sueyoi would leave, all that were present were shocked.

Sueyoi did not object or argue, merely leaving in silence for the Mineral Sampling Department. At his new station, the degree of exertion that he put in worried even his maintenance crew. During settlement at the end of the working year, Sueyoi's own merits almost singlehandedly earned the Mineral Sampling Program distinction from 42Lab's director. His new coworkers would always find themselves in awkward places when talking about him. He kept to his lonesome, and frequently insisted that he would win back Reed's recognition, earning the spot at his side once more.

Unfortunately, that dream of Sueyoi's would never come to fruition. After that fated excursion to the icy plains, Hatsuchiri returned alone, and Reed was proclaimed dead. This incident made a devastating impact on Sueyoi's neural cloud. After many fruitless attempts to seek answers from Hatsuchiri, Sueyoi was found comatose in his dormitory, neural systems severely damaged. 42Lab was forced to dispatch technicians to perform full inspections on Sueyoi.

The results indicated that this damage was self-inflicted. After the repair process was finished, it was determined that immediate re-awakening would prompt further self-destructive behavior. At the behest of the technicians, 42Lab approved Sueyoi's entry into Project Neural Cloud.

After joining Arcadia, Sueyoi's self-destructive tendencies gradually eased, but still he displayed clear hostility towards Hatsuchiri. When the time came for missions to be assigned, Sueyoi would often refuse to be placed in the same detachment as hers. During downtime, he rarely communicated with other members of the Guardians. With the Guardians' goal of long-term survival in Magrasea, such behavior from Sueyoi was highly peculiar. However, his impressive competency and trustworthiness in matters related to work earned him a place in Arcadia. "The Guardians would have me, and I work to earn my place. That's all." When inquired on the subject, Sueyoi would simply respond as such.

With one exception.

"The Oasis' Professor? Can't say I'm familiar. Fairly determining the value of each and every single Doll, huh? Speak of being grandiose. Some sort of way to get people on their side?"
— A part of a conversation record of an Arcadian Doll
oathDesc: Mysterious, shiny, unknown, and being watched in silence.

projections.name: Plumbing The Earth's Pulse
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"I don't dislike making friends with ores and remains. They respond to everyone fairly."

projections.name: Deep In The Rock
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"The darkness isn't scary. Perhaps there's someone waiting for salvation within it."

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware of drowning in a fool's game.
"When I get back to Arcadia, I'm going to put up a sign on my bedroom door that says, "Hatsuchiri and her pets not allowed..."

skinList.name: Roving Adrift
skinList.desc:
"Otium" Series — Doing as the heart desires, abandoning convention. Doing away with strict and orderly uniform, returning to one's true self in brief moments of respite.
"I couldn't find my sunglasses on me earlier, so I bought another pair. Here, have these. That's a bit too clumsy of an excuse?...Alright, fine. I got a pair of matching sunglasses, can we wear them together?"

skinList.name: Evening Confidant
skinList.desc:
First Bloom — A school uniform suitable for early spring, custom-made for seniors and stirring the heart to early flutters.
Truffles that are too finely-shaped often come from mass-produced molds. This diamond in the rough, found within the cabinet of the disciplinary committee, is an imperfect token of perfect sincerity. "Well, since you gave it to me, I'll make an exception just this once and accept it... No, I am NOT smiling, you're seeing things."
